description: Source file implementing a TexturePool class for managing texture buffers in Android's SurfaceFlinger composition engine, including methods for allocation, deallocation, and texture generation.

classes.name: TexturePool
classes.description: Manages a pool of textures for efficient reuse in the SurfaceFlinger composition engine.

methods.name: allocatePool
methods.description: Initializes or resets the texture pool based on current settings.

methods.name: setDisplaySize
methods.description: Sets the display size and reallocates the pool accordingly.

methods.name: borrowTexture
methods.description: Provides a texture from the pool, creating a new one if the pool is empty.

methods.name: returnTexture
methods.description: Returns a texture to the pool if it matches the current size and pool limits.

methods.name: genTexture
methods.description: Generates a new ExternalTexture object with the current size.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the texture pool and reallocates accordingly.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state of the texture pool for debugging.
